Here is a concise picture of **how the Vercel plugin works** in Cursor.

## What it is

The plugin bundles **guidance** (skills), **automation** (commands, hooks), **delegation** (subagents), and a **Vercel MCP server** so the agent and you can reason about Vercel/Next.js and optionally talk to your Vercel account.

## Pieces and how they behave

| Piece | How you use it | What it does |
|--------|----------------|---------------|
| **Skills** (e.g. `vercel-cli`, `deployments-cicd`, `nextjs`, `ai-sdk`) | Type `/` and pick a skill, or the agent uses them when the task matches | Curated playbooks: CLI, deploys, env vars, App Router, AI SDK, etc. |
| **Subagents** (`ai-architect`, `deployment-expert`, `performance-optimizer`) | `/` or the agent routes a big job to them | Focused passes on architecture, deploy/CI, or performance. |
| **Commands** | `/deploy`, `/env`, `/status`, `/bootstrap`, `/marketplace`, `/conventions` | Run scripted flows (deploy, sync env, project status, bootstrap repo, marketplace, conventions). |
| **Hooks** (`SessionStart`, `SessionEnd`) | Nothing manual | Run automatically around sessions (e.g. context injection like knowledge updates). |
| **Rules** | Automatic | Extra instructions the agent follows when relevant. |
| **MCP server `vercel`** | Agent calls tools after login | Live integration with Vercel (projects, deploys, etc. depending on what the server exposes). |

So: **skills/rules** shape answers; **commands** are shortcuts you trigger; **subagents** handle heavier vertical slices; **MCP** is the bridge to your real Vercel data once authenticated.

## Authentication (MCP)

The Vercel MCP server’s `STATUS.md` says it **must be authenticated** before its tools work. You do that by running the **`mcp_auth`** tool on server **`plugin-vercel-vercel`** with empty arguments `{}` (Cursor will walk you through login/consent).

Until that succeeds, the rest of the plugin (skills, commands, subagents) can still help from documentation and patterns; **account-specific actions** need MCP auth.

If you want, say when you are ready to connect Vercel and we can go through the auth step in this workspace.
